description: The monitors that can be added to a site: key, what it catches, whether the current plan allows it, whether it's recommended for this site, and whether it's already added. Before the site's ownership is proven, runsNow says which can run now (started by hand) and which after proof; for a site added as "other", withWordPressPlugin lists what the WordPress plugin adds.
name: list_checks
title: List available monitors
